definitions.short: a round pendant for the neck
definitions.usage: ornament, round tire like the moon.
definitions.full: H7720. saharon [ שַׂהֲרוֺן ] noun [masculine] moon , or crescent ; — only plural הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים of (non-Israelite) ornaments of camels Judg 8:21 , kings 8:26 , women Isa 3:18 , ᵐ5 μηνίσκοι ᵑ9 ( 3:18 ) lunulae ; on crescent as ornament see Dozy ii. 760 Lane Egypt.ii.314 Perles Anal. 79 , compare Frä 58 . שׂוֺא see נשׂא a. I, II. שׂוּג see I, II. סוּג . שׂוּחַ Gen 24:63 see I. שׁוּט .
